explanation.headline: Apixaban is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's records show apixaban is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 131 tablets of apixaban 5 mg at 8.7 a day, providing 15.1 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 274 tablets of apixaban 5 mg at 10.5 a day, providing 26 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
An alternate manufacturer option ranked 3 is Indoco Remedies Limited, also not on FDA's shortage list today with no plant named on its label we could place.
One product label names MSN Laboratories Private Limited in Telangana, India as the manufacturing plant for apixaban, though the plant is not placed in our supply chain.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
